decisions.title: Terminate blocked interactive-fallback tool calls
decisions.rationale: Pi's new terminating block result is a reversible, low-risk way to stop the automatic follow-up model call when ce-workflow rejects work_goal_human_decision because ask_user is available. The existing tool_call guard is the exact shared boundary, so adding terminate removes one unnecessary model turn without changing the decision flow.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-goal.mjs passed and asserts the blocked interactive fallback returns block=true and terminate=true

decisions.title: Provider authentication readiness CLI
decisions.rationale: pi auth check validates provider credential readiness, while ce-workflow's agent health preflight must verify each configured model through the in-process ModelRegistry.complete path, including its actual endpoint and response. Spawning the CLI would add a second runtime-resolution path and still require the current probe; revisit only if Pi exposes a model-level readiness API through the extension context that can replace inference probes without losing coverage.

decisions.title: Host tool-prompt, provider, TUI, theme, and runtime updates
decisions.rationale: Built-in tool prompt contribution exports, Qwen catalog support, fullscreen interaction and rendering fixes, terminal theme probing, Agent.reset safety, and binary startup fixes are host-owned behavior inherited by ce-workflow. This package neither constructs Pi's built-in tool harness nor duplicates those provider and TUI internals, so local adapters would add code without replacing an incumbent path.

decisions.title: Verified private workflow generation
decisions.rationale: The official stable release is translated into the complete private nine-workflow generation with no ordinary CE runtime surface.

decisions.title: Crash-safe subagent TUI compatibility floor
decisions.rationale: The narrow-terminal widget overflow reproduced in a ce-workflow async reviewer can terminate the parent Pi session, and 0.42.1 contains the exact width-bounded rendering fix. Requiring pi-subagents >=0.42.1 is a reversible, one-line compatibility floor that prevents known-unsafe installations without duplicating upstream TUI code.
decisions.verification: npm run verify:quiet passed and validates the pi-subagents >=0.42.1 peer dependency floor

decisions.title: Async workflow timeout and chat-progress compatibility
decisions.rationale: Async workflowScript runs now avoid an implicit 30-minute timeout and unsupported terminal/milestone chat projections were removed inside pi-subagents. ce-workflow's generated workflowScript handoffs use async:true without deprecated chatProgress values or a local timeout shim, so they inherit the corrected lifecycle and quieter projection with no adapter change.

decisions.title: Responsive decision UI and Herdr attention signaling
decisions.rationale: Responsive list layouts and blocked/waiting attention signals are implemented inside pi-ask-user and inherited by ce-workflow's existing ask_user calls. Local dialog policy remains separate and no compatibility shim is required.

decisions.title: ask_user telemetry integration
decisions.rationale: The release exposes no stable per-call telemetry API, while ce-workflow already records tool timing and dialog decisions. Local wrapping would duplicate package behavior without measurable savings; revisit if a public metrics hook appears.

decisions.title: Standalone executable ESM startup fix
decisions.rationale: The removed require() startup crash is wholly inside pi-intercom's executable. ce-workflow uses the extension tool rather than spawning that binary, so it inherits the reliability fix with zero local code and no changed contract.

decisions.title: Active-only autonomous-goal tools
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow now follows pi-goal's lifecycle pattern by exposing work_goal_complete and work_goal_human_decision only while an autonomous goal is active, preserving unrelated tools and failing open when the host lacks active-tool APIs.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-goal.mjs passed and covers inactive, active, needs-human, resumed, and completed tool exposure

decisions.title: Explicit goal replacement semantics
decisions.rationale: pi-goal 0.1.7 changes create_goal to replace an existing goal when explicitly requested. ce-workflow already confirms and replaces an active autonomous goal through startWorkGoal, so no compatibility edit is required.

decisions.title: Replace ce-workflow's goal engine or import pi-goal-writer
decisions.rationale: The generic package and writing skill would duplicate rather than simplify ce-workflow's work-item-aware completion gates, guided decisions, retry recovery, fresh-session continuation, telemetry, and self-improving goal modes.

decisions.title: Checkpoint trust, resumable graphs, and diagnostic quality
decisions.rationale: Checkpoint-bounded secret scanning, trusted cold-start graph resume, stricter structural scans, improved LSP diagnostics, confidence labels, and duplicate suppression directly improve tools ce-workflow already invokes. They are package-owned and require no local adapter.

decisions.title: Standalone build-graph command for verifier cold starts
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow's verifier intentionally falls back when a review graph is cold rather than initiating a workspace-wide build from a read-only checkpoint. Calling build-graph would add latency and trust-scope complexity without improving required correctness; revisit only if measured cold-cache misses materially reduce verifier value.

decisions.title: Prompt-cache and scanner observability surfaces
decisions.rationale: Machine-global cache metrics, CLI output, language coverage, and scanner rule maintenance are pi-lens operational surfaces. ce-workflow consumes bounded diagnostics and has no stable local API or abstraction to replace.
